name: Magic Rinku – AI-Powered Internal Linking for SEO
author: Magic Rinku

sections.description:
Magic Rinku is an AI-powered internal link optimization plugin that helps you build better internal links automatically. By analyzing your WordPress content, Magic Rinku suggests relevant internal links that improve your site’s SEO and user experience.

Overview: How Magic Rinku Works

Get a complete introduction to Magic Rinku and see how AI-powered internal linking can transform your WordPress site’s SEO strategy.

Key Features

  • AI Content Analysis – Advanced AI analyzes your posts and pages to understand content relationships
  • Smart Link Suggestions – Get intelligent recommendations for internal links based on content relevance
  • Multiple Editor Support – Works with Classic Editor, Gutenberg, Elementor, and Beaver Builder
  • SEO Optimization – Improve your site’s internal linking structure for better search engine rankings
  • Easy Integration – Simple setup with minimal configuration required
  • Comprehensive Logging – Track all plugin activities with detailed logging

Building SEO Silos

Learn how to create organized content structures and topic clusters using Magic Rinku’s SEO Silo builder. Group related content together to boost topical authority and search rankings.

Internal Link Suggestions

Discover how Magic Rinku’s AI analyzes your content and provides intelligent internal link recommendations. See how easy it is to implement suggestions and improve your site’s link structure.

Link Graph Viewer

Visualize your entire site’s internal link structure with the interactive Link Graph Viewer. Identify orphaned pages, over-linked content, and opportunities to strengthen your internal linking strategy.

Internal Link Analysis Reports

Deep dive into your site’s linking strategy with comprehensive analysis reports. Track link distribution, identify linking gaps, and optimize your internal link architecture for maximum SEO impact.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the Magic Rinku plugin
  2. Configure your API settings in the admin panel
  3. Magic Rinku analyzes your content and suggests internal links
  4. Review and implement the suggested links to improve your SEO

Editor Compatibility

Magic Rinku supports all major WordPress editors:
* Classic Editor – Full content replacement
* Gutenberg – Block-level updates with automatic conversion
* Elementor – Widget-specific updates and insertions
* Beaver Builder – Module-level content handling

External Service Integration

IMPORTANT PRIVACY NOTICE: This plugin communicates with Magic Rinku’s external API service to provide AI-powered link recommendations.

What Data is Transmitted:
* Post titles, content, and excerpts
* Site URL and basic site information
* Post categories and tags
* Post metadata (publication dates, author information)

When Data is Transmitted:
* When you manually sync content using the plugin interface
* When updating posts/pages through the API (if configured)
* During site analysis for link recommendations

Data Usage:
* Your content is analyzed to generate intelligent internal link suggestions
* No personal user data is stored permanently
* Data is processed securely and used only for providing the service

Third-Party Service:
* Service: Magic Rinku API (https://magicrinku.com)
* Privacy Policy: https://magicrinku.com/privacy-policy
* Terms of Service: https://magicrinku.com/terms-of-service

By using this plugin, you consent to the transmission of your content data to Magic Rinku’s servers for analysis and processing. You can control what content is synced through the plugin’s admin interface.

Privacy Policy

Magic Rinku respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your data. This plugin transmits content data to our external service for analysis purposes only.

Data We Collect:
– Post/page titles and content
– Site URL and basic WordPress information
– Post metadata (categories, tags, dates)

How We Use Your Data:
– Generate AI-powered internal link recommendations
– Analyze content relationships for better suggestions
– Provide plugin functionality and support

Data Storage:
– Content is processed but not permanently stored
– API credentials are stored locally in your WordPress database
– No personal user information is collected or stored

For our complete privacy policy, visit: https://magicrinku.com/privacy-policy

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit:
– Website: https://magicrinku.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/magic-rinku directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Magic Rinku settings page in your WordPress admin
  4. Configure your API settings to connect with Magic Rinku’s service
  5. Start syncing your content to receive AI-powered link recommendations
sections.faq:
Do I need a Magic Rinku account?

Yes, you need to sign up for a Magic Rinku account at Magic Rinku to get your API credentials and access the AI-powered link analysis features.

What content editors are supported?

Magic Rinku supports Classic Editor, Gutenberg (Block Editor), and Elementor. The plugin automatically detects your editor type and provides appropriate integration. Contact our support team to request additional editor support.

Is my content data secure?

Yes, all data transmission is encrypted and your content is processed securely. We only use your content data to provide link recommendations and do not store it permanently. See our privacy policy for full details.

Can I control what content is synced?

Yes, you have full control over what content is synced to Magic Rinku’s service through the plugin’s admin interface. You can choose to sync specific posts, pages, or content types.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No, Magic Rinku processes content analysis on external servers, so it doesn’t impact your website’s performance. The plugin only communicates with our API when you manually trigger syncing or updates.
